name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
December 14, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Richard Velasquez, Olive Branch Calvary Chapel
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Councilmember Sarega
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PRESENTATION OF A COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT AWARD TO LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT DEPUTY ANAYANCY ACOSTA - It is recommended the City Council present a Community Spotlight Award to Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department Deputy Anayancy Acosta.
5.1 Community Spotlight Award
5.2
RECOGNITION OF LIBRARY BOOKMARK CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council and Community Library Manager Allison Ortiz recognize the bookmark contest winners.
5.2 Library Bookmark Contest
5.3
RECOGNITION OF BIOLA UNIVERSITY'S WOMEN'S TRACK AND FIELD TEAM MEMBERS - It is recommended the City Council recognize Biola University's Women's Track and Field members Rebeka Preston and Emily Alvarez for their athletic achievements and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.3 Recognition of Biola's Women's Track & Field Members
5.4
RECOGNITION OF BIOLA UNIVERSITY'S WOMEN'S SOFTBALL TEAM - It is recommended the City Council recognize the athletes and coaches of the Biola University Women's Softball Team and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.4 Recognition of Biola's Women's Softball Team
5.5
INTRODUCTION OF NEW FULL-TIME CITY EMPLOYEES - It is recommended the City Council welcome Christopher Granados, Benny Medina and Drago Reyes-Carreon and present them with a $40 gift certificate to Polly's Pie Restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
5.5 Introduction of New City Employees
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of November 23, 2021.
8.1 Minutes of 11-23-21
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated December 14, 2021 in the total amount of $3,020,459.85..
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
APPROVAL OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT “MUG RUN” - It is recommended the City Council approve the Sheriff’s Department “Mug Run” subject to conditions recommended by staff.
8.3 LASD Mug Run
8.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-07, SLURRY SEAL OF SANTA GERTRUDES AVENUE FROM LEMON DRIVE TO LA MIRADA BOULEVARD AND HILLSBOROUGH DRIVE FROM ALICANTE ROAD TO BEACH BOULEVARD – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Doug Martin Contracting Company, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
8.4 CIP No. 2021-07
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-03, CITY HALL CARPET REPLACEMENT – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Commercial Interior Resources; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
8.5 CIP No. 2021-03
8.6
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING OCTOBER 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending October 2021.
8.6 Investment Report
8.7
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH RALPH ANDERSEN & ASSOCIATES - It is recommended the City Council approve a professional services agreement with Ralph Andersen & Associates to conduct a total compensation study pursuant to the terms of the agreement and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.7 PSA with Ralph Andersen & Associates
8.8
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE SIX CHAIN MOTORS TO MOVE ONSTAGE SCENERY AT THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of six chain motors from Otto Systems at a cost not to exceed $31,854.00.
8.8 Purchase of Six Chain Motors
8.9
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE FOUR FOLLOW-SPOTS FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of four follow-spots from Pacific Coast Entertainment at a cost not to exceed $85,464.98.
8.9 Purchase of Four Follow-Spots
8.10
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE ORCHESTRA PIT EQUIPMENT AND A CLEAR-COM SYSTEM FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of the orchestra pit equipment and clear-com system from Apex Audio, Inc. at a cost not to exceed $72,585.93.
8.10 Purchase of Orchestra Pit Equipment
8.11
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE A STAGE RISER PLATFORM SYSTEM FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of a StageTek stage riser platform system from Wenger Corp. at a cost not to exceed $29,107.46.
8.11 Purchase of a Stage Riser Platform System
8.12
AGREEMENT WITH UNGERBOECK/VENUEOPS FOR VENUE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve a professional services agreement with Ungerboeck/VenueOps to license the use of its venue management software by the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts and authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement on behalf of the City.
8.12 Venue Management Software
8.13
AGREEMENT WITH OLDHAM ARCHITECTS FOR ARCHITECTURAL SERVICES FOR THE UPPER LOUNGE CABARET AT THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve a professional services agreement with Oldham Architects for architectural services for the upper lounge cabaret space for the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts at a cost not to exceed $44,760 and authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement on behalf of the City.
8.13 Architectural Services for the Upper Lounge Cabaret
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO GREATER LOS ANGELES COUNTY VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT - It is recommended the Mayor appoint a delegate to serve on the Greater Los Angeles County Vector Control District for a two year term.
7.1 Appointment
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 21-35 APPROVING PARTICIPATION IN THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE TOBACCO GRANT PROGRAM AND ACCEPTING THE AWARD OF FUNDS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-35 approving participation in the California Department of Justice Tobacco Grant Program and accepting the award of funds.
9.1 Resolution No. 21-35
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 21-36 APPROVING THE APPLICATION FOR GRANT FUNDS FOR THE CALIFORNIA DROUGHT, WATER, PARKS, CLIMATE, COASTAL PROTECTION, AND OUTDOOR ACCESS FOR ALL ACT OF 2018 (PROPOSITION 68) FOR THE LA MIRADA CREEK PARK PEDESTRIAN AND VEHICLE BRIDGE REPLACEMENT PROJECT - It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-36 approving the application for grant funds from the State of California Department of Parks and Recreation grant funding for the Creek Park Pedestrian and Vehicle Bridge Replacement Project.
9.2 Resolution No. 21-36
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
10.
CONSENT CALENDAR: SUCCESSOR AGENCY
10.1
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the Successor Agency approve the warrant register dated December 14, 2021 in the total amount of $1,665,320.
10.1 Warrant Register - Successor Agency

HOUSING SUCCESSOR ANNUAL REPORT REGARDING THE LOW AND MODERATE INCOME HOUSING FUND – FISCAL YEAR 2020-21 - It is recommended the City Council acting in its capacity as the Housing Successor Agency receive and file the Housing Successor Annual Report Regarding the Low and Moderate Income Housing Fund for Fiscal Year 2020-21.
11.1 Housing Successor Annual Report
